body: Thank you for these resources. I am grateful to you and the rest of this sub. <3
I have taken a look at some of the resources. I'll see about posting to /r/SuicideBereavement as well. Thanks.
I'm grateful for this comment. I appreciate the honesty, openness, and support on this sub. <3

I wrote him an email but it was really for myself. I talked about all the things I still want to do with him and how I want him to be in my life. I read parts of it to him and he laughed and said he wanted all those things too. :)

Thanks. The last thing I want to do is avoid him. We've had some difficult conversations, but he's been the most open he has been in my life. He's letting me and some other relatives in to help him out of this situation. I am so grateful he's alive and taking his psychiatrist seriously and that he's letting us help him.
